title: SubscriptionsBalanceLowPayload
description: Payload of `subscriptions.balance.low` version 1. The Wallet paying a subscription is short: the day before the cutoff when it does not cover tomorrow's delivery (`covers_deliveries` 0, with `top_up_by`, the cutoff), or after a cutoff when it covers fewer than three upcoming deliveries. Told once a day per subscription. Consumers: notifications (the customer: how much to top up and by when). Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The store's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

date.description: The next delivery day the warning is about.

amount_needed.description: The least top-up that covers it: the next delivery when it is not covered, else three deliveries.

top_up_by.description: The cutoff the top-up must come before, the day before a delivery not covered; `null` for a warning of fewer than three.

covers_deliveries.description: How many upcoming deliveries the available balance covers: 0, 1 or 2.
